title: Grateful Dead Live at San Francisco Civic Auditorium on 1984-12-31
lineage: Master PCM > DAW (via SEKD Prodif) > Wav; Mastering by Droncit; No changes to the file except for minor edits, fade-ins/fade-outs, and level changes as needed. One short blank space in Jack Straw cut out for flow. Editing with Diamond Cut Forensics 8 and Forensics 9 (alpha). Paragraphic and Spectral Filters applied for equalization.
source: Source: Schoeps CMC441s (90deg, 17cm) > Oade M118 > Oade mod SONY PCM-F1;

ai_review.summary: High‑energy show captured with generally good sound despite occasional distortion
ai_review.review: The performance is remembered as one of the loudest and most explosive nights, with Phil’s bass cutting through powerfully. The recording is mostly clear but exhibits brief moments of distortion that reviewers attribute to the venue’s sound system rather than the tape itself.

ai_rating.rationale: Single enthusiastic review (4 ★) praises the show’s energy and band performance while noting minor distortion; combined show and recording quality merit a solid four‑star rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Occasional distortion noted, likely from the venue PA system; overall clarity is acceptable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The concert is remembered as exceptionally loud and energetic, with a strong band presence throughout.

band_member_comments.Phil: Phil's bass work was highlighted as especially powerful on this night.
